metadata.description: Claude Code skills and plugins from incident management and day-to-day ops work.

plugins.name: postmortem
plugins.description: Blameless postmortems built from evidence: a named clock for every interval, why-ladders that end somewhere real, action items that count as done only when they're durable.

plugins.name: peerreview
plugins.description: Independent review of a finished document by a non-Anthropic model via OpenRouter, reconciled by Claude. Cost shown first; spend capped by a local budget jar.

plugins.name: plain-writing
plugins.description: Write or edit text so it reads like a person wrote it: no hype, no buzzwords, no hedging. Draft mode writes to the rules; review mode marks each AI tell and gives the plain fix.

plugins.name: bash-gate
plugins.description: A hook, not a skill: limits Bash to a read-only policy in unattended claude -p runs, and a verify script proves the gate is live before you trust it. Off unless BASH_GATE is set.

plugins.name: memory-audit
plugins.description: Audit a Claude Code memory folder for orphans, dead index lines, broken links, bad frontmatter, missing paths and memories that just copy a file. Reports only; deleting stays your call.
